integrity: Derivations use the original-time angular equation and a local quadratic-gate limit; reproducibility code is explicitly numerical diagnostic rather than a certificate. The review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Only the fixed unit-circle orbit; no off-circle cycle enumeration, no higher-order error expansion, no uniform global basin results. Two earlier directly relevant full texts were unavailable for inspection, leaving publication-priority uncertainty.
title: Exact period minimum and two-gate critical arrest of the Wilson algebraic cycle
